reproduction_steps: Create a Flask app and attempt to jsonify a response containing a Decimal value
Observe that the built-in encoder raises a TypeError because it does not handle Decimal
expected: Flask JSON encoder should handle Decimal values natively, as it did in Flask 1.1.2, even without simplejson installed
actual: Flask 2.0.1's built-in JSON encoder fails to serialize Decimal types when simplejson is not available, breaking backward compatibility
